seo.description: Royal Galapagos' Calipso: a 16-guest First Class yacht rebuilt in 2019, with a dive deck and jacuzzi. 4, 5 and 8-day naturalist routes, 2026 and 2027 rates.

tagline: A First Class yacht for 16 on 4, 5 and 8-day naturalist routes between San Cristobal and Baltra.
answer: Calipso is a 35-metre First Class yacht rebuilt in 2019 and sailed by Royal Galapagos. She carries 16 guests in twin cabins that mostly convert to doubles, with 9 crew and a bilingual naturalist guide, and has a sundeck jacuzzi. Naturalist routes run 4, 5 or 8 days between San Cristobal and Baltra, from US$2,845 per person.

overview: Calipso is a 35-metre steel and fibreglass yacht that Royal Galapagos says was upgraded and modernised in 2019. She is one of its two First Class yachts.

She takes 16 guests. Royal Galapagos' pages give 8 or 10 cabins, so ask us for the layout; its specifications list twin cabins of 11 to 14 square metres on the Main, Upper and Lower decks, all with private bathrooms, hot water and air conditioning, and all except the Lower Deck cabins convertible to a double bed. There is a lounge, a dining room, a bar, a dive deck and a sundeck with a jacuzzi and al fresco dining, with free Wi-Fi.

The 8-day naturalist week loops from San Cristobal via Bartolome, Santiago, Fernandina, western Isabela, North Seymour, South Plaza, Floreana and Santa Fe. A 5-day section ends at Baltra and a 4-day section starts there.
why: A First Class price with real range: the 8-day week reaches Fernandina and western Isabela from US$6,845 per person in 2027.
Short 4 and 5-day sections between San Cristobal and Baltra, and a whole-yacht charter for 16 from US$39,450 in 2027.

faqs: How many guests does Calipso carry?
Sixteen, with nine crew and a bilingual naturalist guide.
How many cabins does Calipso have?
Royal Galapagos gives eight on its product page and ten in its specifications, so the house says 8 to 10: ask us to confirm the layout for your dates. Most are twins that convert to a double.
How much does a Calipso cruise cost?
Royal Galapagos' 2027 naturalist rack rates are US$6,845 per person for 8 days, US$4,545 for 5 days and US$2,845 for 4 days. Flights and park fees are extra.
Yes. A 2027 whole-yacht charter for 16 is US$94,450 for 8 days or US$39,450 for 4 days.
Which islands does the naturalist week visit?
Bartolome, Santiago, Fernandina, western Isabela, North Seymour, South Plaza, Floreana, Santa Fe and Santa Cruz, from San Cristobal.
Royal Galapagos says she was rebuilt, upgraded and modernised in 2019. Her original build year is not published.
Yes. Royal Galapagos lists free onboard Wi-Fi.
